column1: # TXE-T2 (9 Oct 2026): every no.87 alignment site where the clerk letter stream and the 853-sign sequence are not 1:1, rebuilt from harvest/align87/align_real.tsv against pairs.tsv (letters folded as tools/interlinear_align.py plain_letters). skip: clerk letters the aligner jumped before this row; chunkN: N-letter chunk on one sign; null/insert: sign with no clerk letter; excluded:*: the truth file's own non-scored status (excluded:multi-letter-chunk is listed once, as its chunk).
